quantity.name: temperature profile, with the scalar reference reported at x = 1 m and t = 0.25 s

reference.source: Similarity solution derived from the one-dimensional heat equation on x >= 0 with uniform initial temperature T_i, a surface step T(0,t) = T_s, constant properties, and T -> T_i as x -> infinity: T = T_s + (T_i - T_s) erf[x/(2 sqrt(alpha t))].
reference.confirmed_from: Evaluated independently in verify.py with scipy.special.erf; no literature value is transcribed.

tolerance.metric: maximum normalized L2 temperature-profile error over t = 0.0625, 0.125, and 0.25 s
tolerance.rationale: A 0.2% profile tolerance is tighter than plotting accuracy while allowing the declared finite-element and time-discretization errors; it does not cover domain truncation, which is controlled separately by 4 sqrt(alpha t_end) < L.
